rules: Cardassian government, military, intelligence and resistance presentation are separate organization/state layers.
Military or intelligence clothing cannot be inferred from Cardassian species.
Resistance presentation derives from actual cell/resources/history rather than a universal resistance costume.
Occupation-era and Dominion-era political symbols/markings are temporal state.
allowed_variation: resistance improvised equipment when event state supports
forbidden_variation: Dominion markings before valid political state
permanent occupation iconography after state changes
